incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired: P1 - endpoint /v1/generate us-west-2 high 95th latency (>850ms) — auto-resolve=5m — PD: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD12345
marta: acked, I'm oncall. seeing a short spike on the perf dashboard, checking now :eyes:
alex: i'm jumping in, ping if you need me to run anything
incident-bot: acknowledged by marta
jay: seeing a cluster of 503s around 12:03 UTC in the app logs, looks correlated with higher tail latency, link to logs: https://logs/redwood/stream/abcd
marta: running quick health checks: `kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=runner -o wide`
marta: summary: 3 new runner pods started at 12:02, showing Ready=false initially, Ready=true by ~12:04
owen: readiness probes failing briefly on startup — looks like model weight fetch while readiness probe times out
alex: autoscaling events in infra at 12:01-12:03 — new nodes added, then 1 node removed at 12:05 (autoscaler cooldown?)
jay: useful commands: ```
# check node events
kubectl describe node ip-10-0-2-45
# check pod events
kubectl describe pod inference-runner-78df -n inference
```
marta: pod startup logs show repeated lines: `Downloading model shards: 45% -> 78% -> 100%` then `model loaded, serving ready` ~90-120s after pod start
sre-bot: metric correlation: KV cache miss rate +200% for a 2 minute window, CPU spike on existing runners, network egress up during pod bootstrap
owen: customer impact? error rate bump from 0.1% -> 0.8% for ~3 minutes, but no major customer-facing outages reported
marta: PD page auto-resolved after 5m as alerts returned to baseline :white_check_mark:
alex: preliminary hypothesis: autoscaler added capacity but pod readiness + model prefetch caused a transient capacity gap while new pods completed weight download -> increased tail latency -> alert fired -> recovered once pods ready
jay: mitigation ideas: increase alert window from 1m to 5m for 95th-latency alert to reduce noise from brief startup spikes; consider evaluating p99 vs p95 thresholds separately
marta: agreed. also add a cooldown or gentle ramp to the autoscaler to avoid sailboat spikes at scale events, and increase readiness probe timeout to account for model startup time
owen: filing follow-up ticket INF-5421: "tune model startup readiness and autoscale cooldown" and assigning to eng-runtime
alex: short-term ops note: if PD noise from autoscale flaps repeats, we can temporarily silence via `pd incidents silence PD12345 --duration 10m` (manual) while we triage
marta: no direct customer reports yet, outreach not required at this time
jay: i'll drop a short timeline in #incidents and attach logs + graph snapshots
incident-bot: PagerDuty PD12345 auto-resolved at 1755554567 (auto-resolve window)
marta: closing thread — actions: INF-5421 created, evaluate alert window and readiness probe tomorrow morning. thanks all :slightly_smiling_face:
